title: Organization Evidence Domain
outOfScope: Evidence acquisition, source adapters, persistence, scheduling, reporting, Telegram delivery, scoring, ranking, and stage transitions
Runtime enforcement of budgets, permissions, responsibilities, or management decisions; external system calls and new dependencies
Cross-feature imports and interpretation of organization facts as proof of a production-system stage without additional evidence

riskAssessment.reason: Organization facts influence later production-system evidence review, so the Domain must preserve descriptive facts without turning management, budget, or responsibility changes into automatic stage conclusions.
riskAssessment.reviewNotes: Runtime enforcement, persistence, source linkage, and stage/scoring interpretation are intentionally deferred.

acceptance: src/features/organization/domain exposes OrganizationEvidence, ManagementCommitment, Responsibility, Budget, DecisionRight, and OrganizationAdaptation with validated identities and descriptive facts.
OrganizationEvidence rejects blank identity/name/statement fields and duplicate commitment, responsibility, budget, decision-right, and adaptation identities deterministically.
ManagementCommitment, Responsibility, Budget, and DecisionRight preserve who/what/amount-or-scope facts without enforcing external permissions or performing decisions.
OrganizationAdaptation preserves an explicit description of how an organization change relates to a production-system target without inferring a stage or score.
The Domain remains independent of infrastructure, interface, network, database, LLM, external source, and other feature modules.
Focused unit and integration tests cover validation, duplicate rejection, collection order, commitment, responsibility, budget, decision-right, and adaptation fact preservation.
The design spec and execution plan record the organization-evidence boundary, no-goals, authorization, current-WI issue rule, and verification commands.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep Organization Domain independent of external systems and other feature modules.
Preserve organization facts as evidence; do not infer transformation stages, scores, or production conclusions.
Keep management commitment, responsibility, budget, decision rights, and adaptation relationships explicit.
Do not add dependencies for this contract.
Resolve issues within the current Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; open a successor only for a distinct or materially expanded boundary.
Do not introduce trading, price prediction, or capital-action behavior.

intent.problem: The repository lacks a typed, evidence-preserving model for management commitment, responsibility, budget, decision rights, and organization adaptation related to a changed production system.
constraints: The Domain must retain supplied organization facts without enforcing permissions, allocating resources, or making management decisions.
Organization changes must remain evidence that can be related to a production-system target but cannot independently upgrade a transformation stage.
The implementation must remain provider-agnostic, use existing Rust conventions, and avoid cross-feature imports.
intent.rationale: A pure organization-evidence model gives later stage and reporting WIs a stable, auditable structure for evaluating whether management, responsibility, budget, and decision-right changes support a production-system rewrite.
